purpose: Teach: ウィスキー/俵/ツル/夏期/サクサク/消しゴム/森本/くるみ

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 論文、ウィスキー産業の歴史、丁寧でしたね。
lines.en: Your paper on whiskey-industry history was really thoughtful.
lines.style: Warm, observational opening. Measured pace. Genuine appreciation settling into the final word. Looking at the student with quiet approval.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。米俵を介した経済の章、過去資料、引用しました。
lines.en: Thank you. I included a whole chapter on the rice-trade economy using historical sources.
lines.style: Careful, precise delivery. Slight upward inflection on the sources — showing his work, not bragging. Quiet but steady.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ツル類の保護活動、章末で扱いましたね。
lines.en: And you brought in crane-conservation efforts toward the end.
lines.style: Noticing something that pleased her. Gentle confirmation, not interrogation. Slight lift on the observation — she's checking in, approving.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 夏期の文化研修、海外の例、参考にしました。
lines.en: I drew on examples from summer research abroad. It seemed relevant.
lines.style: Modest, almost tentative. Light touch on 'relevant' — not overselling. Glancing to see if she agrees with his judgment.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 伝統菓子のサクサク食感、製法、興味深いですね。
lines.en: The texture of traditional sweets and how they're made — that's a fascinating detail.
lines.style: Genuine curiosity. Slower pace on 'sweets.' Warm — she's delighting in the specificity he found. Trailing thought, inviting him to say more.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。消しゴム文化、書道との対比、章に入れました。
lines.en: I wanted to contrast eraser culture with calligraphy tradition in that section. It felt connected.
lines.style: Slightly more confident now. Small earnestness on 'connected' — defending the choice gently. Still careful, but he's found his footing.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 森本先生の論考、引用、適切ですね。
lines.en: And citing Morimoto sensei's essay was the right call.
lines.style: Simple affirmation. Direct but not curt. Recognizing his discernment. A teacher saying: you chose well, I notice.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: くるみ栽培の歴史、最終章で論じます。
lines.en: I'm planning to discuss walnut-cultivation history in my final chapter.
lines.style: Steady, forward-looking. Slight pause before 'final' — showing he's thought this through. Quiet confidence settling in.
